items.title: Install Caddy
steps: Install Caddy on alloro-asia via official apt repo; verify binary.
items.evidence: 2026-07-27: Apache removed; Caddy v2.11.4 on 80/443; https://dev-asia.getalloro.com → 200; Signals :3000 still 200.

items.title: Write Caddyfile for alloro-dev
steps: Mirror Apache: reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:3000; WebSocket /socket.io/; disable buffering for /api/minds/ SSE. Keep auto HTTPS.
items.evidence: 2026-07-27: Apache removed; Caddy v2.11.4 on 80/443; https://dev-asia.getalloro.com → 200; Signals :3000 still 200.

items.title: Cutover
steps: Stop+disable+purge apache2; enable+start caddy; confirm ports 80/443 owned by caddy.
Verify: ss -tlnp shows caddy on 80/443; apache gone
items.expected: ss -tlnp shows caddy on 80/443; apache gone
items.evidence: 2026-07-27: Apache removed; Caddy v2.11.4 on 80/443; https://dev-asia.getalloro.com → 200; Signals :3000 still 200.

items.title: Verify alloro-dev
steps: HTTPS GET https://dev-asia.getalloro.com returns app; spot-check socket.io upgrade and /api/minds/ streaming headers if feasible.
Verify: 200 from HTTPS; no Apache process
items.evidence: 2026-07-27: Apache removed; Caddy v2.11.4 on 80/443; https://dev-asia.getalloro.com → 200; Signals :3000 still 200.
